page.title: Tips for creating high-quality property listings
page.description: Discover how to strategically optimise your shared inventory to dominate the Smart MLS search results. Learn the exact ranking boosters - from professional media to emotional copywriting - that put your properties directly in front of active deal makers.
page.body:
Tips for Creating High-Quality Property Listings: Dominating the Grid

In our active co-broking infrastructure, visibility is everything. High-quality photos, detailed descriptions, and comprehensive features are king on PropertyList. The more data you input, the higher your listing will rank within the Smart MLS, putting your property directly in front of active buyers and co-broking agents.

To maximise your strategic advantage and accelerate your sales, ensure you utilise all available ranking boosters when deploying a new mandate to the network.

Strategic Descriptions

Hook potential buyers and agents with unique property features. Paint a picture with your words, targeting both emotional desires (like finding a "dream home") and practical needs (such as being "Close to Schools"). Our internal Smart Search algorithm rewards depth and detail - the more descriptive your text, the better your property will perform on the grid.

Professional Photography

In digital real estate, high-quality photos are critical. Invest in professional shots or utilise a high-end camera with excellent lighting to showcase every room and all outdoor spaces. The volume and quality of your visual assets are direct ranking boosters: the more professional photos you provide, the higher your ranking will be within the PropertyList ecosystem.

Comprehensive Features

Do not skimp on the details! It is vital to highlight all the amazing features that set your exclusive mandate apart. Does the property feature a Private Pool? Is it Close to Beach? Mention them all. The more features you actively select, the more buyers you will attract through our advanced filtering tools.

Immersive Video Tours

To truly stand out, create a video or a virtual walk-through. Providing an immersive digital experience allows potential buyers to explore the property from anywhere in the world, serving as a powerful ranking booster for your listing.
